steps.en: Install the server package and start it with an open chat model
steps.zh: 装好服务端，用任意开源聊天模型起一个进程

steps.en: Loads the model and exposes the classifier endpoint
steps.zh: 加载模型，对外暴露判定接口

steps.en: Send one shared context plus typed questions — choice, score or noul
steps.zh: 发一次请求：一段共享上下文，加一组带类型的问题

steps.en: Builds one v1 prompt per question, prefills the shared prefix once, reads only the answer-label logits
steps.zh: 每题生成一条 v1 提示，共享前缀只算一次，然后只读答案标签那几位 logits

steps.en: Returns JSON answers with a confidence per question; it never generates a token
steps.zh: 返回带置信度的逐问题 JSON；它一个 token 都不生成

steps.en: Label a few examples and fine-tune the answer tokens when the base model is not good enough
steps.zh: 底座不够准时，标几条样本，微调答案 token

steps.en: Merges the adapter and serves it back through the same endpoint
steps.zh: 合并 adapter，用同一个接口把它服务出去

value.en: You get typed per-question answers with a confidence out of a model you already run — no JSON to parse, no classifier head to train
value.zh: 从你已有的模型直接拿到带置信度的逐问题答案——不用解析生成的 JSON，也不用训分类器头

sources: README → Running the HF Server (`python -m pip install -e './hf-server'`, `python hf-server/hf_server.py --model Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B --device cpu --dtype float32`, server listens on `http://127.0.0.1:8000`)

README → How do I use the API? (`POST /v1/classifier`, alias `/v1/systemone`; one of `state`/`messages`; question `type` is `choice` / `score` / `noul`; answers carry `confidence` and `probabilities`; `usage.output_tokens` is zero)

README → How shared prompts and prefill-only scoring reduce work (exact common token prefix found after chat-template + tokenize; prefill once, save KV cache, one suffix per question, read the last real token's logits)

common/README.md → `prepare_prompt(request, version="v1")` returns the cacheable system prefix plus ordered per-question branches; `build_response` turns label logits into answers; "Scores and confidence are not calibrated"

hf-server/README.md → Install and run (`pip install -e './hf-server[test]'`, `simple-jev` console script), Shared-prefix execution, Scope and validation (text only; chat template, copyable cache and single-token labels required)
RFDT/README.md → Prepare labeled data (`python RFDT/prepare.py`), Train a student (`torchrun --standalone --nproc_per_node=4 RFDT/train.py`), Evaluate and export (`python RFDT/export.py`)
eval/README.md → SemIf-derived `data/authored144.jsonl` baseline and the pinned SemIf revision; "No model evaluations have been run for this addition"
.github/workflows/deploy-website.yml → the only workflow: it builds the website and runs `node --test` demo checks (the Python test suites are not in CI)
